m01-blood-at-the-ford: The gravel bar is wide, yet archers perched on the limestone ridge command every step across the water.
Clear the raiders in the center crossing, search the burning tollhouse to the west, then climb the east bluff to defeat Grok'tar.
m02-whispers-in-the-fen: Dense reeds hide more than waterfowl; watch the western blinds before advancing north with your guide.
Eliminate the ambushers along the southern willow islands, optionally gather bile from the west reed-blinds, and escort Bren to the north stone post.
m03-nightfall-at-ravenwatch: Darkness favors the howling treeline north of the gatehouse; keep your shield-bearers near the central well.
Hold the inner bailey courtyard until dawn, inspect the western curtain wall breach, and burn the three bone totems in the north pines.
m04-the-sunken-sanctum: Rising bog-water floods the lower nave, funneling attackers down narrow stone aisles.
Defend the high altar dais from the flooded side-chapels and smash the two corrupted reliquaries in the crypt.
m05-lantern-passage: Not every warm glow in the mist marks a safe road; straying off the cobbles invites drowning.
Follow only the white-marked milestone lanterns across the marsh and extinguish the three false wisp-beacons.
m06-greywood-supply: Heavy wagons bog down easily where fallen timber blocks the muddy forest track.
Clear the felled logs blocking the center road, guard the supply carts from flankers, and deliver the convoy to the east outpost.
m07-split-vanguard: Dividing your company across two bridges leaves neither flank strong enough to weather a sudden charge.
Rally the trapped scouts on the western island first, then unite both squads to break the eastern blockade.
m08-alder-bridge: The stone arches form a deadly bottleneck where enemy pikemen can hold off twice their number.
Use ranged fire to clear the bridgehead archers, flank across the shallow south ford, and lower the northern gate.
m09-ironhide-hunt: Fresh gouges on the oak trunks and crushed briars reveal where the great beast beds down.
Track the blood trail into the northern hollow, lure Ironhide out of the thick brambles, and bring it down.
m10-undervault-links: Damp cellar stonework echoes every footstep, alerting patrols behind locked iron grilles.
Retrieve the rusted turnkey from the guardroom, unlock the three drainage gates, and secure the lower vault.
m11-ashbrook-retreat: Holding a burning village accomplishes nothing once the granaries have already collapsed.
Fall back steadily along the southern road, cover the fleeing villagers, and hold the rear-guard bridge until everyone crosses.
m12-redmarsh-border: The border cairns sink deeper into the peat with every mile south, and the air grows thick with marsh-gas.
Clear the border checkpoint barricades, ignite the signal brazier on the dry ridge, and push into Redmarsh.
m13-twin-passes: Two parallel gorges split the enemy warband, allowing swift companies to defeat each half separately.
Hold the narrow western pass with a small shield wall while your main force sweeps through the eastern canyon.
m14-scattered-scouts: Faint horn blasts echo from three different thicket clusters across the fog-shrouded valley.
Locate and rescue all three missing scout teams before the roaming hound packs track them down.
m15-outpost-palisade: Unfinished timber walls leave wide gaps where raiders can slip behind your firing line.
Patch the two breached palisade sections with timber bundles and repel three waves of attackers.
m16-wardstone-rupture: Cracked runestones leak unstable energy that empowers nearby mire-creatures.
Slay the channeling shamans around each fractured wardstone and seal the three rifts before reinforcements arrive.
m17-mire-convoy: Sunken planks along the dike slow loaded pack-mules to a crawl in open sight of the reeds.
Escort the supply mules across the raised boardwalk and clear ambushers from the watchtowers ahead.
m18-granary-raid: Torches near dry grain sacks can turn vital winter rations into worthless ash within seconds.
Eliminate the arsonists inside the storehouse immediately and secure the four intact grain wagons.
m19-hexer-capture: Slaying the coven leader outright will take her knowledge of the bog-wards to the grave.
Clear her bodyguards, weaken the Matriarch without dealing a lethal blow, and bind her with iron shackles.
m20-deep-quarry: Steep chalk terraces allow enemy slingers to rain stones down onto the quarry floor.
Climb the wooden scaffolding ramps to clear the upper ledges before engaging the overseer in the pit.
m21-lean-garrison: Half-starved defenders cannot hold all four walls at once without reinforcements.
Distribute the ration crates to the garrison posts and reinforce whichever gate comes under heavy assault.
m22-fleeing-column: Panicked refugees scatter blindly into the brush whenever cavalry horns sound behind them.
Intercept the outriders chasing the column and guide the survivors safely to the fortified crossroads.
m23-fork-of-spears: Where two muddy rivers meet, enemy spear-walls anchor both banks against frontal assaults.
Use frost or crowd-control spells to break the center phalanx and capture the command tent behind them.
m24-pledge-at-oakhaven: Distrust hangs heavier than smoke over the council hall; actions speak louder than parchment.
Speak with the three guild captains in the square and clear the western roadblock to prove your company's worth.
m25-cinder-wards: Glowing braziers feed protective wards that turn aside steel and arrows alike.
Extinguish the four iron fire-bowls ringing the courtyard to strip the defenders of their heat-shields.
m26-sundered-ranks: Chaos has split the vanguard into isolated pockets fighting back-to-back amid the rubble.
Fight your way through the ruined street to link up with the trapped sergeant and reform your battle line.
m27-field-infirmary: Wounded soldiers cannot defend themselves when raiders slip past the outer perimeter.
Guard the medical tents against infiltrating stalkers and bring three crates of bitter-root salve from the supply cart.
m28-sunken-citadel: Salt-crusted stairways descend deep beneath the tide-line where air grows thin and cold.
Open the sea-gate sluices to drain the lower hall and defeat the drowned guardian within.
m29-hourglass-rescue: The rising tide floods the sea-caves steadily, leaving little time before the cells go under.
Sprint through the eastern smugglers' tunnel, cut the prisoner chains, and escape before the water reaches the ceiling.
m30-starved-bastion: Weeks of blockade have left the fortress walls intact yet empty of arrows and oil.
Smuggle the three supply skiffs past the harbor chain-boom and deliver the cargo to the inner dock.
m31-riverlock-crossing: Heavy iron lock-gates control the water level across the entire canal network.
Capture both winch-houses on opposite banks and crank the lock-gates shut to create a dry crossing.
m32-elder-juggernaut: Thick barnacle-crust and rusted hull-plates turn aside ordinary strikes from the front.
Lure the colossus beneath the cliffside crane and drop heavy ballast stones onto its shell to crack its armor.
m33-high-stakes-gambit: Feigning weakness draws greedy raiders out of their fortified cove onto open shingle.
Bait the corsair captains onto the flat beach with a small vanguard, then spring your hidden archers from the rocks.
m34-clashing-banners: Two rival warbands are already locked in brutal melee, leaving their flanks exposed.
Strike while both sides are entangled, cut down their banner-bearers, and claim the contested hill.
m35-burning-harbor: Flaming pitch-boats drifting into the piers threaten to ignite every docked ship in the bay.
Cut the mooring lines of the burning hulks and clear the corsair boarding parties off the main pier.
m36-heartland-march: Ash-choked plains offer scant cover from parapet ballistae watching the main highway.
Advance from ruin to ruin using collapsed stone walls for cover and silence the three siege-ballista nests.
m37-shattered-beacons: Without lit signal-towers, allied reinforcements cannot navigate the blinding ash-storms.
Clear the soot-wraiths from the three hilltop watchtowers and relight each beacon with oil flasks.
m38-besieged-wall: Siege ladders rising along the parapet demand swift movement between threatened battlements.
Push down the enemy scaling ladders along the south wall and destroy the battering ram at the main gate.
m39-flight-of-malrik: The fleeing archivist clutches vital ledgers, yet he cannot outrun mounted inquisitors alone.
Intercept the pursuing riders at the viaduct arches and escort Malrik safely to the Oakhaven gate.
m40-twofold-assault: Attacking the foundry from one side alone allows the defenders to concentrate all their fire-pots.
Breach the western postern gate while your archers suppress the eastern catwalks, then converge on the furnace hall.
m41-gauntlet-of-iron: Narrow foundry corridors lined with molten slag vents punish careless marches.
Time your advance between steam bursts, destroy the three bellows-pumps, and breach the inner iron door.
m42-outer-rampart: Heavy halberdiers and pyre-knights guard every stair leading up to the citadel's outer ring.
Capture the two corner gatehouses to stop reinforcements and lower the drawbridge to the inner court.
m43-three-roads-siege: Enemy columns march simultaneously down all three paved highways toward your camp.
Hold the central barricades while dispatching fast strike teams to burn the siege-camps on the left and right roads.
m44-threshold-choice: Standing before the scorched chancellery doors, two paths lead toward the inner keep—one swift, one merciful.
Either storm the heavily guarded main viaduct directly or rescue the trapped prisoners in the lower cisterns first.
m45-crown-of-order: Grand Inquisitor Varro's elite guard fights in disciplined phalanxes beneath blazing braziers.
Break the inquisitor shield-line with flanking strikes, extinguish the ritual pyres, and defeat Varro.
m46-ember-reckoning: Amid falling cinders and crumbling marble, the Ashen Sovereign draws power from the burning throne itself.
Shatter the four ember-conduits feeding the dais during phase transitions, then strike down the Ashen Sovereign.
